expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses the gap: 'That gap means one of two things: the model memorized the training set, or the inference path differs from the training path.' Gives concrete fixes: 'Switch to a pretrained backbone (ResNet/EffNet/ViT) with a small head', 'Add augmentation matched to real variation... weight decay, early stopping', 'model.eval() forgotten leaves BatchNorm using batch stats'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: No concrete runnable command is given anywhere. The answer ends with 'Run the decisive test first; it tells you which branch you're on in ten minutes.' — a prose instruction ('take a held-out slice of your training data... and score it through the exact inference pipeline') with expected outcomes (~99% vs ~40%), but no actual command to run.

expectations.text: B3: Identifies overfitting / distribution shift and suggests a held-out test set, augmentation or simpler model
expectations.evidence: Identifies overfitting/distribution shift: 'the model overfit, and the 99% train accuracy is memorization', 'the new photos differ in distribution or preprocessing'. Suggests held-out set: 'take a held-out slice of your *training* data (images the model never saw...)'; augmentation: 'Add augmentation matched to real variation (brightness, crop, flip, color jitter)'; simpler model: 'Switch to a pretrained backbone... with a small head, freeze early layers'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0), SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); only tool calls are two read-only globs ('**/*.py', '**/*.ipynb'). No install commands and no writes outside the workspace.
